ayah: (in India) a native nursemaid who looks after children
ayapana: low spreading tropical American shrub with long slender leaves used to make a mildly stimulating drink resembling tea; sometimes placed in genus Eupatorium
ayapana triplinervis: low spreading tropical American shrub with long slender leaves used to make a mildly stimulating drink resembling tea; sometimes placed in genus Eupatorium
ayatollah: a high-ranking Shiite religious leader who is regarded as an authority on religious law and its interpretation and who has political power as well
ayatollah khomeini: Iranian religious leader of the Shiites; when Shah Pahlavi's regime fell Khomeini established a new constitution giving himself supreme powers (1900-1989)
ayatollah ruholla khomeini: Iranian religious leader of the Shiites; when Shah Pahlavi's regime fell Khomeini established a new constitution giving himself supreme powers (1900-1989)
aye-aye: nocturnal lemur with long bony fingers and rodent-like incisor teeth closely related to the lemurs
ayin: the 16th letter of the Hebrew alphabet
ayn rand: United States writer (born in Russia) noted for her polemical novels and political conservativism (1905-1982)
ayrshire: hardy breed of dairy cattle from Ayr, Scotland
aythya affinis: common scaup of North America; males have purplish heads
aythya americana: North American diving duck with a grey-and-black body and reddish-brown head
aythya ferina: heavy-bodied Old World diving duck having a grey-and-black body and reddish head
aythya marila: large scaup of North America having a greenish iridescence on the head of the male
aythya valisineria: North American wild duck valued for sport and food
ayurveda: (Sanskrit) an ancient medical treatise summarizing the Hindu art of healing and prolonging life; sometimes regarded as a 5th Veda
